title: Rafael and the Well
author: Jonah Quintana
blurb: Rosalind Dravenmoor, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, has spent fifteen years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must return what was taken in 1974 before the well refills.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
